brief:
A classified document accidentally shared by an Israeli operative revealed a plan by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Mossad chief to strike Iran before the upcoming Israeli election, Middle East Eye reported. The breach alerted Washington, prompting U.S. intervention to disrupt the operation.

Channel 12 said the inadvertent disclosure by the Israeli operative triggered American response, though details of the U.S. actions remained unclear.

title: Leak exposes Netanyahu plan to attack Iran before Israeli election
